transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I've been feeling completely unmotivated and emotionally flat for about two years and three months now. I've also socially withdrawn from everyone around me. It's just really hard to find the energy to care about anything anymore.
Have you ever heard or seen things that others don’t, or strongly believed things others said weren’t true? If so, did that ever happen during a time when you were not feeling depressed?
No, I haven't really experienced hearing or seeing things that other people don't. I also haven't had any strong beliefs that others disagreed with.

Over these past two years, was there ever a period of two months or longer when you felt mostly back to your usual self? Or have the low mood and lack of motivation been there nearly every day the whole time?

I'm not quite sure, to be honest. It's really hard to remember a time over the last two years when I felt completely back to my usual self. It feels like this flat feeling has just been there pretty much the whole time.
During these past two years, have you actually felt sad or down most days, or has it been more a loss of interest and low motivation without feeling depressed?

It's definitely more of a complete loss of interest in things I used to enjoy rather than feeling sad. I just have zero motivation to start or finish any activities. This lack of drive has been going on for about two years and three months now.
During this time, have you also had changes in sleep, appetite or weight, low energy, poor concentration, low self-esteem, hopelessness, or feelings of guilt?

No, I haven't really noticed any changes in my sleep or appetite, and I don't feel hopeless or guilty. It's just the lack of motivation and flat feeling I mentioned before, but none of those other issues.

At any point during these two years, was there ever a two-week period when your symptoms became clearly worse and you had several other depression symptoms nearly every day, like sad mood, sleep or appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, guilt, or hopelessness?

No, I haven't experienced any specific two-week period where my mood became significantly worse with those kinds of symptoms. I've never really dealt with guilt, hopelessness, or changes in my sleep and appetite. It has just been the same flat, unmotivated feeling the whole time.
How much has this lack of motivation affected your daily life, like work or school, self-care, and relationships?

It has severely impacted everything; I struggle to even do basic self-care like showering, and I can't keep up with any work. I've also completely lost interest in talking to my friends or family, so I've isolated myself from everyone. This struggle to do anything or connect with people has been going on constantly for over two years now.
Even if sadness wasn’t the main problem, during these two years did you feel down or depressed more days than not, or mostly just emotionally flat and uninterested?

I haven't really felt sad or depressed in a typical way during this time. Instead, I've just felt completely flat, empty, and totally uninterested in any activities for the past two years and three months. This complete lack of emotion and interest has been the main feeling for me.
During this period, have you had poor concentration or trouble making decisions nearly every day?
No, I haven't really noticed any trouble with my concentration or making decisions. That hasn't been an issue for me during this time.
Nearly every day during this period, have you felt physically tired or low in energy, or is it mainly that you just don’t feel interested or motivated?

It is definitely more of a lack of interest and motivation rather than being physically tired. I just struggle to find any drive to start or participate in activities. It feels like I'm completely empty of any desire to do things.
